name: finem-architecture
description: Define system boundaries, domain rules and clear interfaces so implementation can evolve without spreading coupling.

interface.shortDescription: System design, domains and API contracts.
interface.longDescription:
Define system boundaries, domain rules and clear interfaces so implementation can evolve without spreading coupling.

Covers: Architecture, ADRs, Domain modeling, API contracts.

Expected outputs: System and module boundaries; Domain model and terminology; Architecture decision records; API contracts and integration boundaries.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: gstack:plan-eng-review, wshobson:architecture-patterns, addy:documentation-and-adrs, addy:api-and-interface-design.

Optional specialist and framework packs: agent-engineering, backend-hono, backend-fastify, backend-fastapi, api-graphql, api-contract-testing, xylex-architecture, xylex-code-audit. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: eraser, context7. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for Architecture & API Design and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review Architecture & API Design in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
